exceptions.justification: Transitive via licensee's own dependency-resolution internals (npm's arborist/pacote/sigstore stack, needed for REGISTRY package-fetch/verify operations). This package's own use of licensee only reads local node_modules license metadata already on disk (`licensee --production --errors-only --ndjson` against an installed tree); the registry-fetch code path that would actually exercise arborist never runs.
exceptions.alternatives: A pinned older licensee (8.2.0, via npm audit fix --force) avoids this specific arborist range but is an unverified major downgrade with its own CLI/flag-parsing differences (already hit one docopt-parsing incompatibility with the current licensee major line during this repo's own setup).
exceptions.remediation: Revisit when licensee ships a patched release in its current major line, or when a verified upgrade path to licensee 12.x lands.

exceptions.justification: Transitive via github-actionlint, used only to lint this repository's own committed .github/workflows/*.yml during npm run contract -- never extracts an untrusted archive; adm-zip's actual vulnerable code path (zip extraction) is never exercised.
exceptions.alternatives: No fix available at any adm-zip version; github-actionlint itself has no alternative extraction-free release.
exceptions.remediation: None available; revisit if github-actionlint drops or replaces its adm-zip dependency.

exceptions.remediation: Revisit when markdownlint-cli2 ships a release with a patched smol-toml.
